output.headline: Mbeki's Early Goal Lifts Ironvale Past Northgate
output.text: What a tight one! Northgate Rovers kept the ball more and looked tidy, but Ironvale Athletic had the sharper bite. In the 27th minute, Zeke Mbeki swept home from right in front of goal, set up by Ivo Petrov, and the home side led 1-0. Moments earlier, Oscar Blum had a big chance for Northgate blocked, so it could easily have gone the other way. After that, Ironvale sat deep, won the ball back again and again with tackles and interceptions, and made Northgate work for every inch. Mbeki nearly added a second just before the break. Northgate pushed hard but couldn't find an equaliser. Mbeki was the standout, scoring the winner.
